taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航A350機上網路服務有差異　搭機前留意Wi-Fi供應與免費使用資格
taiwan_aviation.summary: 搭乘中華航空Airbus A350-900，機上網路體驗仍可能有所不同。華航在機上Wi-Fi官方說明中，將A350、B777及A321neo列為提供服務的機型，同時明確註明「特定 A350、A321neo 航機暫無提供 Wi-Fi」。因此，訂位資料顯示A350-900，或使用A359代碼，並不能直接當作該班機一定可上網的保證。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines A350 Wi-Fi Availability and Complimentary Access Can Differ
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: A China Airlines Airbus A350-900 booking does not guarantee internet access. The airline lists the A350, B777 and A321neo as types offering onboard Wi-Fi, but explicitly excludes certain A350 and A321neo aircraft. An A359 aircraft code alone therefore cannot confirm availability.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航前四川航空A350補強運能　331席客艙、服務差異與改裝安排解析
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空引進前四川航空Airbus A350-900，增加可調度的廣體客機，但同一個A350機型名稱之下，旅客實際遇到的客艙並不完全相同。這批航機的加入，涉及運能補強、原有座艙配置與後續升級等不同階段；飛機換上華航塗裝並投入服務，並不表示座椅、娛樂設備及機上網路已全部換成華航原有A350的產品規格。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines’ Ex-Sichuan A350s Add Capacity While Cabin Products and Upgrade Timelines Differ
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines’ introduction of Airbus A350-900s formerly operated by Sichuan Airlines adds widebody capacity, but does not make every A350 cabin identical. Fleet entry, the retained seating layout and subsequent product upgrades are separate stages. China Airlines branding alone does not establish that seats, entertainment and connectivity have all been converted to its original A350 specifications.

international_aviation.summary_en: BAE Systems announced on October 21, 2026, that the TRV-150 intercepted multiple one-way attack drones during a single flight at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida. The trial took place in late September 2026 as part of a Joint Readiness Experimentation exercise.

international_aviation.headline: 奇瑞公佈兩款凌霄電動垂直起降概念機
international_aviation.summary: 奇瑞在年度全球創新大會公佈兩款「凌霄」品牌電動垂直起降（eVTOL）概念機。大會於2026年10月20日在安徽省蕪湖舉行。報導指出，兩項飛行器計畫目前的狀態與開發時程資訊有限。凌霄Q212為雙座全電動機型，採複合翼及升力與巡航推進架構，最高速度可達每小時120公里，滿載飛行續航約一小時。
international_aviation.headline_en: Chery unveils two Lingxiao eVTOL concepts at annual conference
international_aviation.summary_en: Chery announced two eVTOL concepts under its Lingxiao brand at its annual Global Innovation Conference, held in Wuhu in Anhui province on October 20, 2026. The report says information about the programs’ status and development timeframe is currently scarce. The Lingxiao Q212 is an all-electric, two-seat eVTOL with a compound-wing and lift-and-cruise propulsion architecture. It should be able to reach speeds of up to 120 km/h, with around an hour of flight endurance at full load.
